'''Tammy''' (Japanese: '''トモー''' ''Tomo'') is a supporting character who appeared in ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. She owns a flower shop in [[Crown City]] that she operates with her {{p|Tangrowth}}. She is also good friends with {{OBP|Joe|M13}}.

==History==
Tammy and {{OBP|Joe|M13}}, a close friend of hers, were first seen fleeing from the intense flames left behind by an {{p|Entei}} by taking refuge in her flower shop. All the while, they were unaware that the Entei was actually an illusion created by a {{OBP|Zoroark|M13}}.

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} first met her after her {{p|Tangrowth}} put {{OBP|Zorua|M13}} to sleep. She was excited to see [[Karl]], Joe's grandson, after being away from Crown City for a while, and invited everyone back to her shop for tea. There, she explained the legend of {{OBP|Legendary beasts|M13|the city's guardians}}, as well as the story of the disaster that befell Crown City twenty years prior. Tammy, like Joe, refused to evacuate like the other townspeople because they believed that the city's guardians would not seek to destroy Crown City, like the news had been claiming.

Her suspicions proved to be correct, as she and Joe later witnessed the real city's guardians {{pkmn|battle|battling}} against Zoroark. She joined Ash, his friends, Karl, and [[Rowena]] at Joe's workshop. They soon discovered [[Grings Kodai]]'s scheme to steal the [[Time Ripple]]'s power. Tammy became fearful of the city's destruction occurring again, and urged Ash and his friends to do something.

Tammy and Joe later joined Ash and his friends after they foiled Kodai's plot. She was overjoyed to see the city's plants intact, and watched as {{OBP|Celebi|M13}} made several plants grow before it [[time travel]]led away. She was among those who confronted Kodai and witnessed his arrest by [[Officer Jenny]]. Afterwards, she joined Ash, his friends, and Joe at the seaport to see Karl, Rowena, {{OBP|Zorua|M13}}, and Zoroark set sail for the [[Unova]] [[region]].
